cases.title: English typing
actions: Use the English keyboard and type ok, then press Return.
observations: The prompt cursor stays visible while typing. The snapshot contains one ok and one Return.

cases.title: Ukrainian typing
actions: Use the Ukrainian keyboard and type ї, then press Return.
observations: The keyboard enters ї once and the prompt cursor stays visible.

cases.title: Composition commit
actions: Use a qualified stock keyboard gesture to hold é in visible preedit.
Commit é once without pressing Return.
observations: Preedit is visible with zero recorded bytes.
Preedit closes and the final snapshot contains only one é.

cases.title: Composition replacement
actions: Use a qualified stock keyboard gesture to show é in preedit.
Replace it with è while still composing, then commit è once.
observations: The visible preedit changes from é to è with zero recorded bytes.
Preedit closes and only è reaches the recorder.

cases.title: Composition cancellation
actions: Use a qualified stock keyboard gesture to show é in preedit.
Cancel the composition without submitting it.
observations: Preedit is visible with zero recorded bytes and disappears on cancellation.
The snapshot stays empty after cancellation.

cases.title: Short Unicode paste
actions: Use Paste sample once to send Їж through the terminal.
For touch qualification, use the same sample with the iPhone’s Paste action in a fresh attempt.
observations: Paste is available at the focused prompt and the sample is captured once.

cases.title: Multiline Unicode paste
actions: Use Paste sample once to send ї, é and 界 on three lines (LF then CRLF).
For touch qualification, use the same three lines with the iPhone’s Paste action in a fresh attempt.
observations: The three lines are captured in order with one carriage return at each line break.

cases.title: Touch selection and copy
actions: Select COPY-Ї using touch handles and use Copy.
Keep the fixture foregrounded, paste into Verify copied token, and confirm that it matches COPY-Ї. Use Read last and verify the native snapshot is empty on the same generation.
observations: The handles select exactly COPY-Ї and the clipboard contains that token.
The terminal snapshot stays empty.

cases.title: Touch scrolling
actions: Swipe into the transcript history until earlier numbered lines appear.
Swipe back to the prompt.
observations: Earlier lines become visible and the prompt and cursor return.
Scrolling produces zero input bytes.

cases.title: Cursor with keyboard open
actions: Dismiss the keyboard and note the prompt location.
Tap the prompt to open the software keyboard.
observations: The prompt and cursor are visible and unobscured with the keyboard open.
Opening the keyboard produces zero input bytes.

cases.title: Portrait and landscape rotation
actions: With the prompt visible in portrait, rotate to landscape.
Rotate back to portrait.
observations: The prompt and cursor remain visible in both orientations and after returning.
Rotation produces zero input bytes.

cases.title: App switch and return
actions: Type a, then read the initial snapshot.
Switch to another app and return. Read the retained snapshot.
Start a fresh attempt and type b.
observations: The prompt is visible on return and the retained snapshot still contains only a.
The fresh attempt contains only b.

cases.title: Lock and return
actions: Type c, then read the initial snapshot.
Lock and unlock the iPhone, then return. Read the retained snapshot.
Start a fresh attempt and type d.
observations: The prompt is visible on return and the retained snapshot still contains only c.
The fresh attempt contains only d.
